An '''akia''' was one of the four clans of [[Aramandi]] society. The four clans were the [[Cirra]], [[Orma (akia)|Orma]], [[Mila (akia)|Mila]], and [[Lota]]. The central religious text of Aramandi society, the [[Eeronon]], established the system and taught that while all Aramand must share the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Aram]] and the [[Aramand system/Legends|Aramand system]], they were destined to take control of another [[Star system/Legends|star system]] within the [[Aramand Cluster]]. Each akia worked towards the colonization of their chosen system. By the time of the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], the Orma had established their colony and been in residence for several hundred years.<ref name="FBS" />

On Aram, each akia controlled their own [[City/Legends|cities]] and territories, with zones open to members of other akia and even offworlders. They also maintained private areas reserved for the members of the akia. The capital, [[Talerakia]], was shared by all akia and was divided into four areas, each one controlled by an individual clan. All akia answered to a neutral ruler known as the [[Taal]].<ref name="FBS" />
